extracted.name: Honey Garlic Vinaigrette
extracted.description: Serve this honey vinegar dressing with garlic for company and enjoy all the praise. You will love the contrast between the snappy garlic and the sweet honey.
instruction_lines: In a container, combine oil, vinegar, honey, and garlic. Cover, and shake until blended. Set aside for 45 minutes, to allow flavors to combine. Shake again before serving.
